BREAKING: Starship Flight 13 has been scrubbed for today. 🚀

• No Starship launch will take place today.
• SpaceX teams will review the issue and determine the cause before setting the next launch attempt.
• The company will announce its recycle timeline and next launch opportunity once the analysis is complete.
• Updates will be shared through SpaceX's official channels as more information becomes available.

The countdown may be on hold, but Flight 13 is expected to return for another launch attempt soon.

Video

SpaceX designed Starbase's launch pad with one goal in mind: launch as fast as possible.

"We designed this pad to support a launch every 60 minutes indefinitely."

The first launch pad wasn't meant to be perfect. It was built quickly so the team could learn.

"We didn't know what we were doing because no one had ever done something like this before."

After a static fire, a massive chain inside the tower's chopstick system failed. The team diagnosed the problem, sourced replacement parts from Cape Canaveral, flew them overnight, rebuilt the system, and had the pad back in service in about 36 hours.

That's the SpaceX philosophy: build, test, break, fix, improve, and keep moving.

BREAKING: Tesla's Shanghai Gigafactory is strengthening its role as the company's global export hub. 🇨🇳

• Vehicle exports doubled to 229,000 in H1 2026
• Tesla is now China's #6 vehicle exporter
• June exports climbed to 36,000, more than 3× higher year over year
• Giga Shanghai produced 56% of Tesla's 838,000 global deliveries in the first half of 2026
• China-built Model Y became the best-selling imported EV in South Korea, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand

Giga Shanghai continues to power Tesla's global expansion, supplying vehicles to key markets across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond.
